organization.description: Athlos Oy is a Finnish X-ray imaging technology company specialising in direct conversion CdTe-CMOS and Si-CMOS sensors for dental, medical, and industrial applications.

product.description: Fully wireless direct conversion intraoral X-ray sensor. Si-CMOS technology, Bluetooth 5.0, Zero Profile® holders. FDA 510(k) cleared.

offer.description: Available through authorised dental imaging dealers and distributors. Contact Athlos for quote.

q1.question: Is DC-Air® FDA cleared?
q1.answer: Yes. DC-Air® is FDA 510(k) cleared for dental intraoral X-ray imaging.

q2.question: How does DC-Air® connect wirelessly?
q2.answer: DC-Air® uses Bluetooth 5.0 wireless connectivity. No receiver dongle or docking station is required.

q3.question: What sensor sizes are available for DC-Air®?
q3.answer: DC-Air® is available in Size 1 and Size 2.

q4.question: Is DC-Air® available in Europe?
q4.answer: CE registration is currently under way. DC-Air® is not yet on sale in Europe.

q5.question: What imaging technology does DC-Air® use?
q5.answer: DC-Air® uses Si-CMOS direct conversion technology, which converts X-ray photons directly into electrical signals without an intermediate scintillator layer — delivering sharper detail and higher contrast than conventional intraoral sensors.
